status: FROZEN. eval_v1 (semeval21_test.jsonl, unchanged) plus a second source. Do not modify; a change means eval_v3.

headlines_llm.what: 70 real news headlines (titles only) from 35 outlets' RSS feeds, fetched 2026-11-14
headlines_llm.annotator: ONE LLM annotator. NOT human annotation; no second annotator; no kappa.
headlines_llm.protocol: Labels were decided from the headline text alone, before any ensemble output on these headlines was seen. Headlines were picked by the annotator from a random sample of 140 (4 random per outlet), so the set is not a random sample of all news and several borderline cases were left out.
caveats: The annotator and the ensemble's models are all general-purpose LLMs: errors may be correlated.
Single annotator: label noise is unknown; some calls are borderline.
Replace or supplement with two human annotators when available.
